verdicts.evidence: Too little time has passed since the Aug 2026 call to evaluate the multi-year deal value reported up to Sep 2026.
The regional revenue mix breakdown required to test the European business percentage is not provided in the quarterly table.
Too little time has passed to evaluate Year 1 EPS accretion based on data reported in Sep 2026.
The transaction closing date falls within future quarters beyond the Sep 2026 report.
Too little time has passed to verify Year 1 cash EPS accretion from the Aug 2026 call to the Sep 2026 report.
The long-term intent to repay loans over time cannot be fully assessed in the single quarter reported after the call.
Corporate structural agreements like property loss transfer agreements are qualitative goals not captured in the financial results table.
Goodwill and intangible splits and amortization schedules are qualitative or balance-sheet specifics not measurable from the quarterly revenue and profit table.
Capital raising intentions such as QIP or stake dilution are qualitative corporate actions not testable from the financial results table.
The target to reach a USD 2 billion run rate by FY27 is set for a future fiscal year, with Sep 2026 showing revenue of 4664.0 crore.
Evaluating the Q4 exit run rate of FY27 is premature as only quarters up to Sep 2026 are reported.
Management aspired for margins in the 16% to 17% range, but reported OPM% was 16.2% in Jun 2026 and dropped to 13.6% in Sep 2026.
The March 2027 $2 billion aspiration is a future goal beyond the reported Sep 2026 quarter.
Effective Tax Rate figures are not provided in the quarterly table, which only lists revenue, operating profit, OPM%, and net profit.
